title: US sanctions Dubai-based crypto exchange over alleged IRGC funding
content: The United States sanctioned Dubai-based Shelbit for processing millions for Iran's state entities. This action targets sanctions evasion through cryptocurrency networks, as announced by the Treasury Department. Shelbit allegedly facilitated transactions for Iran's central bank and the IRGC. The exchange denied all allegations and stated operations ceased in January 2026. Dubai's regulator also previously found Shelbit violated anti-money laundering rules.

title: India rejects US criticism of FCRA Bill; MEA calls it 'internal matter'
content: The government is set to expedite the Foreign Contributions Regulation Act, which focuses on managing foreign funding for organizations. In contrast to criticism from a US Congressman regarding proposed changes, the administration remains resolute. Home Minister Amit Shah has met with church leaders to resolve their issues. The Bill's discussion and possible approval in Parliament are imminent.

title: India counters China's 'map war', assigns official names to 27 Arunachal sites
content: India ahs onsistently rejected Beijing's practice of assigning Chinese names to places in Arunachal Pradesh, describing the exercise as "vain and preposterous". India has maintained that such actions do not change the "undeniable" fact that the state "was, is, and will" remain an integral part of the country. Several of the newly marked locations hold strategic importance because of their proximity to the Line of Actual Control (LAC).

title: 'Unnecessary pressure': Ex-cricketer questions Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's vice-captaincy

The young talent, aged just 15, will support Ishan Kishan in this significant role. Sooryavanshi earned recognition after his Player of the Series performance in Zimbabwe, leading selectors to justify their choice as part of a broader development strategy. The tournament kicks off on August 23 in Bengaluru.

title: Elon Musk's preferred state halts data center approvals; says 'prove' this

Developers must prove electricity and water use, and tax incentives.  Abbott stated Texans must come first in all state decisions.  This move addresses growing scrutiny over rapid data center expansion.

title: NEET row: CBI claims NTA experts breached 'secrecy pact', face life term, Rs 1cr fine
content: The integrity of the NEET-UG 2026 examination was compromised as three NTA subject experts were reportedly involved in leaking confidential question papers. The CBI has taken action by filing a chargesheet against them in a Delhi court. Accused of engaging in criminal conspiracy and cheating under recently established laws, these individuals may face severe repercussions, including substantial fines and potential life imprisonment.

title: Michael Dell's son Zach Dell wants his Base Power batteries in every American backyard

Base Power recently secured one billion dollars in new funding, valuing it at thirteen billion.  This expansion includes plans for international markets like the United Kingdom and Germany.  The firm is also increasing its battery manufacturing capacity to meet growing demand.

title: Police put up posters of Lashkar commander across J&K, declare Rs 15L reward
content: Authorities are on the hunt for Lashkar commander Mohammad Lateef Bhat throughout Kashmir and Jammu, offering a significant cash reward for information that can lead to his capture. Bhat has been linked to the targeted murders of a police officer and two migrants. In a separate incident, an SUV attempted to run over officers at a Ramban checkpoint, resulting in one arrest after the vehicle was seized.

title: Mongolian herders sing to reunite rejected baby camels with their mothers
content: In Mongolia, herders engage in Khööslökh, a heartfelt tradition that involves singing to mother camels. This ritual is crucial for ensuring that newborn calves are welcomed and nurtured by their mothers. Accompanied by the soothing sounds of the morin khuur, a horsehead fiddle, herders believe the melodies forge a deep emotional bond that enhances maternal acceptance. Recognized by UNESCO, this practice embodies a blend of compassion and musical artistry.

title: Houston man’s solo trash cleanups grow into 100-volunteer movement
content: A Houston resident's initiative to clean up neglected areas has blossomed into a vibrant volunteer movement. With one hundred dedicated individuals now on board, their mission is to remove illegally dumped waste. Collaborating with local organizations and harnessing the power of social media, city officials and law enforcement are boosting efforts to tackle this pressing issue, ultimately enhancing the community's aesthetics and the well-being of its residents.

title: Minnesota solar farms turn into wildflower havens, invites bee and butterflies
content: Minnesota solar farms seeded with native plants tripled insect abundance. Native bees increased twentyfold, and more bird species were observed. Taller solar panel arrays allow more native species to grow underneath. Native prairie habitat costs less than gravel over the solar farm's life. Most American solar farms currently lack documented pollinator habitat.

title: Jaaved Jaaferi on kids losing patience and what parents can do about screen time
content: Jaaved Jaaferi, the Bollywood actor, has highlighted a concerning trend regarding children's diminishing attention spans linked to excessive screen time. He recounted a striking moment when his son struggled to appreciate a sunset for even ten minutes. Experts suggest that the constant barrage of digital stimulation diminishes the reward of slower, enriching activities.

title: Pradeep Rawat's son Vikramaditya recalls actor's battle with blood cancer at prayer meet

title: US appeals court halts Trump's $400 million ballroom project
content: a US federal appeals court on Friday ordered president Donald Trump's administration to halt construction of a proposed $400 million ballroom at the white house . in a 2-1 ruling, the US Court of Appeals for the district of Columbia upheld a preliminary injunction obtained by the National Trust for Historic Preservation . the court put its order on hold for 14 days, giving the administration time to appeal to the US Supreme Court .
